name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Dallas TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off the south access road (Cleveland Rd) is an open, uncontrolled driveway gap in the perimeter fence. Confirmed in Street View (pano JN2dM160Jh-ODXOFYRZS_A, 2026-04, heading 0): wide paved opening, a Kroger monument sign on the right, rows of blue Kroger Delivery vans inside, no barrier arm and no checkpoint pinch-point at the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance in any Street View heading along the south road or Telephone Rd. The only small structures on site are utility/MEP buildings (generator/refrigeration plant) deep in the SW truck court, not a gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Site outbound is via small Kroger Delivery vans (this is an e-grocery CFC, not a trailer-heavy DC). The south van staging lot holds ~20-30 marked van stalls; banded 10-25. Few full trailers (drop trailers without tractor) seen.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; the lots hold delivery vans, not parked trailers.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest dock bank along the building's west/southwest wall (~15-25 doors estimated from z20-21; a couple of trailers/box trucks backed in). Automated CFCs receive bulk inbound by trailer and ship by van, so dock count is lower than a conventional 350k sq ft DC.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Wide open entrance apron; estimated ~2 inbound / 1 outbound at the street, but lanes are unstriped at the property line so this is approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: South Dallas (75241), inside the dense I-20 logistics corridor near other large DCs; clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 33.8 acres is the fenced/paved operational footprint traced from the perimeter polygon; press reporting cites a 55-acre tract (the balance is undeveloped wooded land to the west, outside the operating geofence).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
